name: TOMSO
summary: TOMSO, or 5-TOMSO, also known as 2-methoxy-4-methyl-5-methylsulfinylamphetamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and amphetamine families related to the DOx series. It is the analogue of DOM in which the methoxy group at the 5 position has been replaced with a sulfur-containing methylsulfinyl group.

pharmacology.text: TOMSO was reported to produce no or only threshold effects by itself at the assessed doses, but when alcohol was concomitantly ingested, clear hallucinogenic effects occurred.
